snippet.title: Portal 2: Thoughts - Teaser
snippet.description:
Portal 2: Thoughts is a fan-made mod, taking place some time after the finale of the main game. 

Aperture Science is gradually recovering from the final events of Portal 2. The lab still keeps many secrets, and you are one of them. You play as an old Atlas robot prototype, miraculously preserved since 1985. Time flies, technology advances, but for some reason the rusty old bot is still of interest to the lab staff.

This mod runs on Strata Source (Portal 2: Community Edition).

Comming soon to Steam (I hope). There have been some difficulties communicating with Steamworks support.

ModDB: https://www.moddb.com/mods/portal-2-thoughts

KeyCam was used to film some moments of this teaser: 
https://github.com/LaVashikk/P2-KeyCam
